name: Sleet Storm
summary: Sleet fills a 20-foot-radius Cylinder: Heavily Obscured, Difficult Terrain, Dex save or Prone and lose Concentration.
text: Until the spell ends, sleet falls in a Cylinder 20 feet in radius and 40 feet tall centered on a point you choose within 150 feet. The area is Heavily Obscured, and exposed flames in it are put out. The ground in the Cylinder is Difficult Terrain. When a creature enters the Cylinder for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Dexterity saving throw; on a failure it has the Prone condition and loses Concentration.
